producer_source.scope: Exact checked-out source for a start-only refinement diagnostic; not a completed tensile result.

scope: Completed immutable protocol and saved-state grid-decoupling audit. Does not establish experimental accuracy, fracture-energy convergence, resolved fragment surfaces, or uninterrupted-run equivalence. Same-frame failure and separation do not resolve causal ordering.

coordinate_neck_audit.method: Fixed reference axial slabs of thickness four particle spacings; narrowest median of three consecutive central slabs within 10% gauge length, normalized by the same reference slabs; remote median widths at 25–35%; y envelope plus one spacing. Current active XY raster at one spacing, dilated one pixel, 8-connected across gauge. Orthographic z projection.
coordinate_neck_audit.scope: Projected geometric ligament at particle resolution; does not establish a resolved three-dimensional material surface or experimental accuracy.
